svg.data-weight-note: 21.5 kg (47.4 lb) with 2 PSUs and 4 fans installed - both documents agree
svg.data-mac-addresses: 8K exact match, 128K without exact match (subject to NOS)
svg.data-power-budget-per-port-w: 24 on ports 1-4, 29-36 and 61-64; 13 on all other ports
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 40 C (32 to 104 F) at sea level; 0 to 35 C (32 to 95 F) at 1828 m
svg.data-software: ONIE preloaded; compatible with Open Network Linux and Enterprise SONiC by Edgecore
svg.data-optics-qsfp-dd: datasheet: each QSFP56-DD port takes 1 x 400G QSFP56-DD, 1 x 100G QSFP28 or 1 x 40G QSFP+, or breaks out to 2 x 200G (2 x 4 lanes 50G PAM4), 4 x 100G (4 x 2 lanes 50G PAM4), 2 x 50G (2 x 2 lanes 25G NRZ), 4 x 25G NRZ or 4 x 10G NRZ. The guide's lamp legend lists the same set and adds the 1 x 8 lanes 50G PAM4 mode for 400G.
svg.data-dac-reach: datasheet interfaces table: the sixteen 24 W ports "Support 400G QSFP56-DD DAC up to 2.5m" and the other forty-eight "up to 1m". The extra watts buy reach.
svg.data-emissions: EN 55032 Class A, EN 61000-3-2, EN 61000-3-3, VCCI-CISPR 32 Class A, AS/NZS CISPR 32 Class A, ICES-003 Issue 7 Class A, FCC Class A

g.data-description: the sixty-four 400G QSFP56-DD ports, in TWO BANKS OF SIXTEEN STACKED COLUMNS on a single 23.868 mm pitch with no ganging - ports 1-32 the upper bank and 33-64 the lower, numbered down each column from 1 at the top left, with the legend `N (up)(down) N+1` printed BETWEEN the two cages of its column. SIXTEEN OF THEM ARE 24 W PORTS - 1-4, 29-36 and 61-64, the first two and last two columns of each bank - and the datasheet names them individually. The other forty-eight are 13 W. The extra watts buy DAC reach: 2.5 m against 1 m.
